composers_checked.name: Henze, Hans Werner
composers_checked.note: Five quartets, the piano-trio Adagio adagio, the Neue Volkslieder quintet, Selbst- und Zwiegespräche and the Törless sextet kept. Kammersonate and Trio in drei Sätzen added from Apple Music recordings. No recording or performance found for Quintetto (piano and quartet), Amicizia!, Quattro Fantasie (octet), Adagio for string sextet; Canzona (seven instruments, scoring not found) and Concerto per il Marigny (eight players) kept on a Domaine Musical recording without a duration; Kammermusik 1958 has ten players.

composers_checked.name: Rihm, Wolfgang
composers_checked.note: Thirteen quartets listed on Wikipedia: Nos. 1-12 recorded (Minguet Quartett complete set; No. 13 not found recorded). Years of Nos. 10-12 were not confirmed. Interscriptum (quartet and piano, Arditti with Nicolas Hodges) and Fetzen 1-8 (quartet and accordion) added. Not kept: Geste zu Vedova (scoring unverified), Chiffre I-III and V-VIII and Kolchis (ensemble sizes or scorings unverified), duos.

composers_checked.name: Lachenmann, Helmut
composers_checked.note: Gran Torso (benchmark), Quartets 2 and 3, Streichtrio I, temA, Trio fluido and Allegro sostenuto kept. Mes Adieux (Streichtrio II, 2021-22) not found recorded; the other chamber works are duos, solos or large ensemble (Mouvement, Concertini, Marche fatale).

composers_checked.name: Widmann, Jörg
composers_checked.note: Quartets 1-5, Octet, Clarinet Quintet, Passacaglia, Nachtstück, Es war einmal, Sieben Abgesänge and the Torso (cross-listed with violin 4995) kept. Tränen der Musen added. Not found recorded: Fieberphantasie, Dubairische Tänze, Studies on Beethoven (Quartets 6-10); 180 beats per minute is recorded only for string orchestra and quartet.

composers_checked.name: Haas, Georg Friedrich
composers_checked.note: Quartets 1, 2, 4, 6 and 7, the Sextet and Blumenwiese kept. Quartets 3 (In iij. Noct.), 5 and 8-11, LAIR, BTZM, Dido, Tombeau and framing... are published (UE) but no recording was found in the lookups.

composers_checked.name: Zimmermann, Bernd Alois
composers_checked.note: String Trio (1944, IMSLP/Schott) kept on a documented 2016 concert; no recording found. Présence added. Quartet (1944-45) and the duos/solos not in scope or no source.

composers_checked.name: Stockhausen, Karlheinz
composers_checked.note: Helikopter-Streichquartett kept. Kurzwellen (six players, scoring not verified), Dr. K-Sextett (only a 4-minute excerpt on a 1989 disc), Hoffnung, Glanz and Erwachen (Stockhausen-Verlag CDs, not found on the streaming catalogues) left out; Kontra-Punkte has ten players.

composers_checked.name: Kagel, Mauricio
composers_checked.note: Quartets 1-4, Pan, Piano Trios 1-2, Match, Motetten and the Jazzstücke kept. Left out: Sextet (1953-57), Aus dem Nachlass, Tango Alemán, Ragtime à trois, Der Schall and Mare Nostrum (no recording found or scoring not confirmed).

composers_checked.name: Holliger, Heinz
composers_checked.note: Two quartets kept. Toronto-Exercises added. Machaut-Transkriptionen (voices with strings, scoring not confirmed), Ma'mounia and the oboe/viola/harp trio not found recorded or not verified.

composers_checked.name: Neuwirth, Olga
composers_checked.note: Two quartets and Quasare/Pulsare II kept. in the realms of the unreal (quartet No. 3), voluta/sospeso and ...ad auras... (two violins with optional drum) not found recorded or out of scope.

composers_checked.name: Pintscher, Matthias
composers_checked.note: Quartet No. 4 and three Figura pieces kept; Study IV added as a string quartet (scoring inferred from the JACK Quartet programme). Study II, svelto added from Apple Music; Quartets 1-3 not found recorded.

composers_checked.name: Furrer, Beat
composers_checked.note: String Quartet No. 3, spur, Retour an Dich, ...cold and calm and moving and Aer kept. Quartets 1, 2 and 4, Für Alfred Schlee, Sei Venuta di Marzo, Aria and the Clarinet Quintet (2016) not found recorded.

composers_checked.name: Czernowin, Chaya
composers_checked.note: Hidden, the String Quartet (1995), the sextet and Die Kreuzung kept. Anea Crystal (two quartets and octet), Fast Darkness III (sextet, 2022) and EZOV (Quartet No. 4, 2024) not found recorded.

composers_checked.name: Larcher, Thomas
composers_checked.note: Quartets 1-3, Kraken and My Illness Is the Medicine I Need kept. Kraken added. Quartet No. 4 (lucid dreams) and the piano-trio version of A Padmore Cycle (only the tenor and piano version is recorded) not found.

composers_checked.name: Reimann, Aribert
composers_checked.note: Unrevealed kept under the vocal rule. Shine and Dark (Cherubini Quartett) and the Schumann-type arrangements not kept: scoring/arranger unconfirmed; ...oder soll es Tod bedeuten? is an arrangement of Mendelssohn songs.

composers_checked.name: Saunders, Rebecca
composers_checked.note: Five ensemble works with strings and the quartets Fletch and Unbreathed kept. Behind the Velvet Curtain, Trio (1992), Stirrings and Stirrings Still II not found recorded or the recorded scoring not confirmed; to and fro (violin catalogue 4842) and Duo are duos.

composers_checked.name: Poppe, Enno
composers_checked.note: Trauben and Freizeit kept. The string quartets Tier and Buch, Wald (four quartets), the Quintet and Stoff/Brot (ensemble scorings not confirmed) were not found recorded.

composers_checked.name: Gruber, H.K.
composers_checked.note: Chamber works with strings (Trio gioco a tre for piano trio, Op. 12, 1963) were searched on Deezer and Apple; no commercial recording found. Violin catalogue 1441 is for solo violin.

note: EVIDENCE: Deezer album pages (label, year, track timings; album ids in sources) are the main recording evidence, with Apple composerTerm song searches (collection ids in the notes), MusicBrainz work lists with recordings (Henze, Rihm, Lachenmann, Widmann, Haas, Zimmermann) and the en/de Wikipedia work lists for scorings and years. Also opened: the Chimes/Schott page for Widmann's Torso, the Deutsche Radio Philharmonie programme PDF of 4 Dec 2016 (Zimmermann's String Trio) and the Europadisc page for NEOS12006 (Haas). Naxos, Presto, the UE, Schott and Breitkopf catalogues and IRCAM were not opened; publishers are taken from Wikipedia and the violin catalogue's notes. IMSLP: only Zimmermann's String Trio (kept on the 2016 concert, no recording found); every other work is added from work lists plus recordings. VIOLIN CATALOGUE: 4995 (Widmann, Torso for two violins and piano) is cross-listed; 467 (Haas, Fuga for two violins), 4795 (Rihm, Dyade, violin and double bass) and 4842 (Saunders, to and fro, violin and oboe) are duos; the other violin entries are solos, duos, concertos or violin with orchestra or 19 strings (Widmann 4992); Pintscher's Mar'eh ensemble version (4761) was not checked for size. OWNER MAY RULE: (1) voice-with-ensemble works kept under the vocal rule: Rihm's Et Lux (four voices and string quartet), Widmann's Quartet No. 5 (soprano; the Minguet recording credits no singer) and Sieben Abgesaenge, Larcher's My Illness Is the Medicine I Need, Reimann's Unrevealed, Lachenmann's temA (flute, voice, cello) and Zimmermann's Presence (piano trio with a speaker); (2) Widmann's Torso rests on the Schott edition and the violin catalogue's premiere note, with no recording or programme found (confidence low); (3) Zimmermann's String Trio rests on one regional radio-orchestra concert programme. WEAK SPOTS: years left blank for Rihm Nos. 10-12, Grave, Verzeichnis and Et Lux, and for Holliger No. 2 and Kagel's Motetten; Haas Nos. 4 and 7 have no duration and may use electronics; Haas's Sextet date (1982) comes from Wikipedia only; Furrer's Retour an Dich is 1986 on Wikipedia but 1984 on the Kairos track list; Czernowin's sextet is assumed to be 2 violins, 2 violas, 2 cellos; Henze's Quartet No. 4 runs 35 minutes on the Arditti set; Saunders's dichroic seventeen is 1996 on Wikipedia and 1998 on the Kairos track list; levels are estimates not checked against scores. NOT FOUND RECORDED OR NOT VERIFIED: Henze's Quintetto, Amicizia!, Quattro Fantasie; Rihm's Quartet No. 13; Lachenmann's Mes Adieux; Widmann's Fieberphantasie, Dubairische Taenze and Beethoven studies; Haas's Quartets 3, 5, 8-11 (published by UE); Stockhausen's Dr. K-Sextett, Hoffnung, Glanz and Kurzwellen; Holliger's Machaut-Transkriptionen; Furrer's Quartets 1, 2 and 4; Poppe's Tier and Buch quartets; Gruber's Trio gioco a tre. No composer is proposed for exclusion.
